portability_contract.shared_logic: Separate application/document algorithms from platform adapters.
portability_contract.display: Query dimensions and attributes; use semantic colors and clipping.
portability_contract.memory: Bounded buffers and handles for banked objects; report allocation failures.
portability_contract.storage: Versioned, explicitly encoded records; no persisted pointers or raw C structures.
portability_contract.migration: Recompile for the target, adapt OS-specific modules and test resource limits. This does not expand the listed supported platforms.

data.launch_positioning: Independent BPI Systems partner software, demonstrated after Abacus at NCC 1978. Separately licensed and optionally combined by dealers with Logix hardware and AION applications; never an automatically included Logix product.

specification.company_and_support: BPI retains product ownership, independent management, licensing, updates and specialist support; Adam investment and AION engineering cooperation are disclosed. Dealers provide first-line installation support; Logix supports hardware.

summary_export.format: Versioned delimited-text file on disk with named columns, period, currency, account identifiers, decimal amounts and control totals.
summary_export.scope: Selected balances or monthly totals imported into Abacus as planning inputs. No automatic write-back, concurrent execution or live database link. Close BPI before loading Abacus.
summary_export.acceptance: Reconcile record counts and control totals; validate rounding, quoting, disk-full errors, memory use and save/reopen. Prepared demo data is labelled.

launch_acceptance: Measured 48 KB workspace, disk capacity and supported disk configuration; 64 KB or extra drives only when qualified and separately quoted.
Posting consistency, correction history, disk-full handling and tested backup/restore.
Readable reports on launch display and supported printers; supported forms and paper documented.
Payroll jurisdictions, update process and maintenance responsibility explicitly documented.
specification.commercial_policy: Credit documented net amounts paid for eligible same-platform BPI module licences against one complete-suite upgrade, capped at current suite price; no cash refund, duplicate licence or training/setup credit. Retire credited module entitlements. Support and paid setup costs require separate budgets.
